SHINDOは、会津地方を主拠点に、食・住・エネルギー・健康・共育という生命の基: SHINDO is an initiative, based mainly in the Aizu region, to build the foundations of life — food, housing, energy, health, and shared learning — with our own hands.

WORLDVIEW ── SHINDOに至る歴史観: WORLDVIEW ── The view of history that led to SHINDO
食べるものは誰かがつくり、エネルギーは遠くから届き、住まいは買うもので、学びは学: Someone else grows our food, energy arrives from far away, a home is something you buy, and learning happens at school. The ways people once supported one another have been replaced by services paid for with money. Over the past eighty years life has become astonishingly convenient — and at the same time we have lost the ability to support the foundations of our own lives.
安価なエネルギーが手に入ること。世界が平和で、流通が滞らないこと。お金の価値が保: That cheap energy will be available. That the world will stay at peace and supply chains will keep moving. That money will hold its value and food will keep being imported. Yet abrupt climate shifts, conflicts over resources, structural change driven by AI, farming that is losing its farmers, and wavering trust in currencies — every one of those assumptions is being shaken.
A NEW BEGINNING ── 新しい「はじまり」のとき: A NEW BEGINNING ── A time to begin again
大転換期を乗り越える「村的な土台」を創造する: Creating a village-scale foundation to carry us through a great transition
いまは「終わりの始まり」ではなく、互いに「共鳴して創るとき」。恐れから創るのでは: This is not the beginning of the end; it is a time to create together, in resonance with one another. Not to build out of fear, but out of the wish to live better. That difference will profoundly shape the world that is created from here.
SHINDOが創っていくのは、毎年実る土、湧き続ける水、住み継げる家、世界を生き: What SHINDO creates are living assets: soil that bears fruit every year, water that keeps flowing, houses that can be lived in for generations, the wisdom to make it through the world, and companions to create and live with.
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING ── 何を創ろうとしているのか: WHAT WE ARE BUILDING ── What we are trying to create
私たちが創ろうとしているのは、これからの時代にも生命を繋ぐことができる、新しい「: What we are trying to build is a new operating system for everyday life, one that can keep life going in the era ahead. Rather than leaning on outside dependence, we will raise five foundations that we can maintain and renew ourselves, step by step toward 2030. They are not separate businesses; they grow together, linked within a single village.
